description: Send an order request for a part to KinetiCAD. Call this only after the user has seen the price and said yes, and has given a shipping address and an email address. It sends those details to KinetiCAD. No payment is taken: Bera Demirhan at KinetiCAD emails the user within 1 business day with the confirmed price and delivery date, and the user pays only after agreeing. Ships within the US only.

email.description: Where KinetiCAD sends the confirmed price and delivery date.

material.description: What the part is machined from.

notes.description: Anything the shop should know: threads, fits, finish, a date the parts are needed by.

part_id.description: The part_id that build_part (or the HTTP upload of a STEP file) returned.

state.description: US state, two letters, for example CA.

name: request_order
title: Request an order
